description: Shared CrossModalLab experiment configuration. ULVO and standard-Python contributors must use these pinned values for comparable scientific runs. Do not change model revision or quantization without an approved protocol amendment.

model.notes: Primary research model. Weights are external assets; see datasets/metadata/smolvlm2_acquisition_manifest.json and docs/ASSET_MANIFEST.md.

quantization.notes: Pinned on the primary RTX 2050 (4 GB VRAM) workflow. Not assumed portable to every contributor GPU.

prompt_template.notes: Exact spacing of candidate answers is part of the scoring protocol.

scoring.notes: Candidate-normalized softmax scores are not calibrated correctness probabilities.

splits.note: Holdout/out-of-distribution splits remain symbolic-generator controlled; do not edit ground-truth JSONL by hand.
